title: The Quarry Wakes
summary: A colossal rusted dredging machine claws up out of a flooded quarry at dusk while a soldier in a mustard coat crouches behind a toppled crane: A it rises, B its leg slams the rim.
request: arcade style at 304x224, delivered 4x, checked one layer at a time against the neogeo era. A 6-second boss reveal for an invented game: a colossal rusted dredging machine claws up out of a flooded quarry at dusk (bucket-chain jaw, piston legs, a cabin with one cracked lit window, moss in its seams); a soldier in a mustard coat crouches behind a toppled crane on the right. Two stills of its best moments and a 5 s FM sting.

outputs.name: sting
outputs.run: python3 sound/sting.py && ffmpeg -y -loglevel error -i sound/06-sample.wav -codec:a libmp3lame -q:a 2 sound/06-sample.mp3

anatomy.draws: The scene brief: intent, arcade style, layers per era, layout, palette roles, sound plan
anatomy.change_for: intent, mood and the written rules the gate reads

anatomy.draws: One strict Neo Geo 15-bit palette by named roles (cold world, warm boss and soldier)
The cold world: dusk sky with an ember band, terraced quarry walls, flooded pit, near rim with a toppled lattice crane
The dredger boss as part sprites with pivots (hull, cabin, stack, jaw, bucket links, piston legs) and the A and B poses
The crouched soldier as a joint rig, poses brace (A) and flinch (B)
Opaque palette-cell effects: water crown, cascades, exhaust puffs, slam dust and debris
Composes moments A and B; exports 4x frames, 1x copies, four era layers per image, actor masks, palette.json and the parts sheet
Boss part sprites of pose A on one transparent sheet with pivots (boss-parts.json)
FM boss sting in E minor at 168 bpm, ending on the slam, synthesised in numpy
